g.text: Three repetitions; bands show min–max. Gray region: workers span both NUMA nodes.
KD hollow circle: local execution in every repetition; diamond: mixed local/JIT repetitions.
Filled KD marker: at least one returned JIT body per repetition. Host 10.176.26.71; collector CPU 63.
